title: Pizza Connection 3 / Barro's Pizza unified release acceptance

truth_policy.rule: This overlay aggregates existing truth contracts. A referenced contract or release gate is complete only from retained evidence; source presence, readiness diagnostics, mockups and plans are not runtime proof.
truth_policy.promotion: The ecosystem may be called 100% complete only when every release_required gate below is PASS and each referenced contract is itself complete.
truth_policy.snapshot_rule: Visual claims require retained screenshots from the actual running Workbench, Studio or game. CI offscreen renders are useful preflight evidence but do not replace live-game proof.

runtime_profiles.rule: These are separate exact runtime profiles. Assembly hashes, PathIDs and scene/runtime facts are never treated as interchangeable.
